name: Shai-Osudoku District Hospital
description: The Shai-Osudoku District Hospital is the only major government health institution in the Shai-Osudoku District, with about 244 bed capacity, 14 wards and two operating theatres. Established in 1970 as a health post, later became a Health Centre in 1985 and a district hospital in mid-2009. Located in Dodowa, the capital of Shai-Osudoku District.

name: Lekma Hospital – Teshie
description: The Lekma Hospital is a governmental health facility built by the Chinese Government in 2010 as a friendship hospital. It is a 100-bed capacity hospital with units including laboratory and radiological facilities, a Malaria Research Centre and a Herbal Medicine Unit. It serves as the municipal hospital for the Ledzokuku-Krowor (Teshie and Nungua) area and beyond. The hospital’s clinical staff includes 22 doctors (9 specialists) and over 200 nurses. It opened a special eye centre in 2013.

name: Saint Luke Hospital, Kasei
description: The St Luke Hospital, Kasei, is a mission hospital under the Luke Society Missions to provide holistic, affordable health services according to Christian principles on a non-commercial cost effective basis. It is located at Kasei via Ejura. The facility is a medium sized hospital with seventy (70) beds capacity in the Ejura Sekyeredumase Municipality and the Ashanti Region of Ghana.
